strapiBlog.title: Meydan Awards AED 529 Million Contract for Naya District One Dubai
strapiBlog.short_description: Meydan, a renowned master developer in Dubai, has awarded a significant AED 529 million ($144 million) contract to Bhatia General Contracting Co.

data.text:
Meydan, a renowned master developer in Dubai, has awarded a significant AED 529 million ($144 million) contract to Bhatia General Contracting Co. This major initiative aims to bring to life Meydan Naya District One, a world-class residential development within the iconic Mohammed Bin Rashid City.

Khalid Al Malik, Chief Executive Officer at Dubai Holding Real Estate, expressed confidence in the collaboration, stating: 

"With its sophisticated design and curated amenities, Naya at District One sets a new standard for master-planned residential developments in the UAE. Here, residents can connect with nature, enjoy resort-style amenities, and experience the very best of upscale living. We are pleased to partner with an experienced company like Bhatia General Contracting Co. on this project to turn our vision for Naya into reality and further enrich Dubai’s vibrant real estate landscape."

Ajay Bhatia, Chairman of Bhatia General Contracting, also expressed enthusiasm for the project: 

"We are honoured to work with Dubai Holding Real Estate for the construction of Naya at District One and bring our expertise and innovation to a project that epitomises luxury and precision. Our decades of experience and unwavering commitment to quality will ensure timely delivery of this exceptional development, reflecting our shared vision for excellence."

data.text:
About Naya District One Dubai

Naya District One Dubai consists of three striking green-roof residential towers, offering spacious one to four-bedroom apartments alongside Lagoon Villas complete with private gardens and terraces. 

Scheduled for completion in 2027, this exclusive gated community is designed with wellness and security in mind. Residents will enjoy 24/7 security and an array of resort-style amenities, including a state-of-the-art gym, basketball and padel courts, expansive green spaces, and a rooftop lounge. Families will benefit from a dedicated kids' play area, an infinity pool with cabanas, and direct access to the 35-hectare crystal lagoon, which offers recreational activities such as kayaking and paddleboarding.

Located just four kilometers from Downtown Dubai, Meydan Naya District One provides seamless access to key landmarks like The Meydan Hotel, Meydan Golf Course, and Meydan Racecourse. Its connectivity to major road networks ensures a tranquil yet highly accessible living experience.

Lagoon-Side Living at Naya

The highlight of the development is its unique lagoon-side living experience, offering residents unparalleled access to the 35-hectare lagoon. With crystal-clear waters and a range of water sports facilities, this feature redefines the concept of upscale, waterfront living in Dubai.

Investment Opportunities with Provident Estate

For investors looking to tap into Dubai's thriving real estate market, Naya District One Dubai presents a premium opportunity. Collaborating with Provident Estate ensures a hassle-free investment process, with expert guidance and exclusive access to this prestigious project. Provident Estate is dedicated to helping investors maximize their returns and secure a stake in this remarkable development.
